market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool has consistently been a top-4 contender, making it in 4 of the last 5 seasons. Despite the managerial transition from Klopp to Slot, the squad retains world-class talent and solid depth. The market appears to undervalue their chances at 52.5%, whereas I estimate around 70% probability based on recent performance and squad strength.
evidence_points: Finished top 4 in 4 of the last 5 EPL seasons (only missed 2022–23).
Squad includes key players like Salah, Van Dijk, and Alisson, ensuring a high floor.
New manager Arne Slot led Feyenoord to an Eredivisie title, suggesting tactical competence.
sources_consulted: Recent news on Liverpool squad and management changes
